from.place: the proof's opening comparison principle: precomposition by a quasi-isomorphism induces a bijection on morphisms into a K-injective complex

title: Comparison principle for a K-injective target
statement:
Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] for which the derived category exists. If $s:A\to B$ is a quasi-isomorphism of cochain complexes and $I$ is K-injective [def-sp-kinjective-bridge], then precomposition induces a bijection

$$
 s^*:\operatorname{Hom}_{K(\mathcal A)}(B,I)\longrightarrow\operatorname{Hom}_{K(\mathcal A)}(A,I).
$$
